title: Local realization of a finitely presented module at a site point
statement: Let $C$ be a site small in the coefficient universe and having finite limits [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on $C$, let $p:\mathbf{Set}\to\operatorname{Sh}(C)$ be a point [def-trf-geometric-morphism], and set $R_p=p^{-1}R$. Let $M$ be a finitely presented $R_p$-module [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. There exist an object $U$ of $C$, an element $x\in p^{-1}(h_U^\#)$, and a sheaf $F$ of $R_U$-modules on the localized site $C/U$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with the following properties. Here $h_U(V)=\operatorname{Hom}_C(V,U)$ and $h_U^\#$ is its sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. The element $x$ specifies a point $q:\mathbf{Set}\to\operatorname{Sh}(C/U)$ with $j_Uq\cong p$, where $j_U^{-1}$ is restriction to $C/U$. There are canonical identifications $q^{-1}R_U\cong R_p$ and $q^{-1}(G|_U)\cong p^{-1}G$, natural in all $R$-module sheaves $G$, and an $R_p$-linear isomorphism $q^{-1}F\cong M$. The sheaf $F$ can be chosen as the cokernel of a map $R_U^a\to R_U^b$ given by a finite matrix with entries in $R(U)$, for some natural numbers $a,b$.
